questions.subject: Warm-up
questions.prompt: Welcome to XP Daily. What happens if you honestly don't know an answer?
options: Tap Skip — no penalty, it just tells the system what to teach
Text your son for the answer
questions.answer: Tap Skip — no penalty, it just tells the system what to teach
questions.why: The skip button is coverage intelligence, not failure. Every skip teaches the ledger where the real gaps are — guessing hides them.

questions.subject: Warm-up
questions.prompt: Your real quizzes start Monday, built from a per-topic mastery ledger. Who decides what you get asked?
options: Deterministic code reading your ledger — AI only writes the wording
questions.answer: Deterministic code reading your ledger — AI only writes the wording
questions.why: The architecture law: the ledger is the brain, code owns every scheduling decision. AI never keeps score.

questions.subject: Warm-up
questions.prompt: You're about to sit Year 8 content all week. Solve like it's 1998: what is 15% of 80?
questions.why: 10% of 80 is 8, and 5% is half that (4). 8 + 4 = 12. Welcome back to Year 8 — Monday won't be this gentle.
